fusions.name: Shut in Silk
fusions.desc: Wraps an enemy, which deals 12 damage, stuns it for 1.2 seconds, leaves it [Pinned] for 3 seconds and 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Bar by Bar
fusions.desc: Drops 3 hardened threads in a spread out to 7 tiles, each of which deals 6 damage, with a 35% chance to leave its target [Hindered] for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Closed Circle
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: No Way Out
fusions.desc: Against an enemy below half health, your damage rises 12%.
